full_track.tags: K-Indie, Bossa Nova. Acoustic guitar plays syncopated jazz chords with a nylon-string timbre. A soft, breathy female vocal performs a melodic line with light vibrato. Upright bass follows the guitar with a steady two-beat pattern. Percussion consists of a shaker and a subtle rimshot on the backbeat. The arrangement is sparse and intimate. Key of G Major. Tempo is 110 BPM.
